'''Syo Bakarn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Master Bakarn relocated to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he served as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. However, Bakarn himself was unaware that he was host to a second personality, the '''First Son''' of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].

==Biography==
===Seeds planted===
{{Quote|Yes, I remember&hellip;my father and I, walking Axial Park. He said, "Syo, we were&hellip;once&hellip;"|Syo Bakarn remembers his childhood on Corellia|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Bakvalen_Hall.png|thumb|left|250px|Bakarn's family residence, Bakvalen Hall]]
Syo Bakarn was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" /> native of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Old Blood" /> Born around [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="Birth date" /> he was a member of the [[Bakarn family]],<ref name="Old Blood" /> which had once carried the name Bakvalen. The Bakvalens had at one point been a well-known [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] noble lineage, living in [[Guardian Hold Four|Bakvalen Hall]], their own manor in the capital city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]].<ref name="Bakvalen codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bakvalen family (Consular)}}</ref> Bakarn was born during a time of turmoil, as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was engaged in the [[Great Galactic War]] with the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], led by the enigmatic [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Seeking to further his [[Sith Emperor's power base|power base]], the Sith Emperor decided to create a group of personal [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]]s called "[[Children of the Emperor]]." The Emperor's agents, [[Servant]]s of the clandestine organization [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], scoured the galaxy for Force-sensitive beings suited for their Master's needs. Like many infants from many different species, Bakarn was spirited away from his family on Corellia<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and he was taken to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to undergo training in a specialized group.<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|the Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref> For weeks, Bakarn and the other children underwent various rituals and processes inside the Academy,<ref name="Blood of the Empire 3">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref> until eventually Bakarn was chosen to be the first individual to be inducted into the ranks of the Children of the Emperor.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The young Bakarn was granted a personal audience with the Sith Emperor, whereupon he was infused with the Emperor's strength and was bound to his mind and will, becoming the [[Emperor's First Son]].<ref name="Chaos and Harmony" /> The First Son was essentially another persona created inside Bakarn's mind, who was unaware of its existence. A master strategist, the First Son would lay dormant inside the labyrinths of Bakarn's mind, waiting for the Emperor's command to awaken and do his Master's bidding.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After his initiation, Bakarn was returned by the Emperor's Hand to his parents, as eventually were the other Children. Thus, a network of sleeper agents was spread by the Sith Emperor throughout both the Republic and his own Sith Empire.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The First Son, bound through the Force to the other Children, continued to sleep inside Bakarn. However, he constantly projected a mental shield, hiding himself and the other Children of the Emperor from being detected by other Force-sensitives.<ref name="First Son codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The First Son (Consular)}}</ref> As long as the First Son lived, the Children were undetectable by the galaxy at large. Having no memories of his experiences at the Sith Academy and unaware of the second personality inside him,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Bakarn continued to live with his parents on Corellia. He and his father at one point took a walk in [[Axial Park]], when his father told him about their family's proud past.<ref name="Old Blood" /> Eventually, Bakarn's Force-sensitivity was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He was taken from his homeworld and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], becoming a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to a [[Syo Bakarn's Jedi Master|Jedi Master]]. During his time as a Padawan, Bakarn gained recognition after he saved his Master from an attack by a [[Unidentified Mandalorian Jedi hunter|Mandalorian Jedi hunter]]. Eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and studying as a [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], Bakarn focused his studies on his [[Force healing/Legends|healing skills]], eventually becoming a noted [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]].<ref name="Bakarn codex" />

===Helping rebuild===
[[File:Syo_Bakarn.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Syo Bakarn during the Battle of Rhen Var]]
As a Jedi Knight, Bakarn joined the war effort and fought on the front lines of the Great Galactic War. Although he displayed great combat prowess on the battlefields, Bakarn found no enjoyment in fighting and preferred to channel his talents on healing and rebuilding. As such, Bakarn made it his priority to tend to wounded Republic soldiers after each battle.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> At one point in his life, he distributed ancient medicine across the alleways of his native [[Coronet City]]. Such actions earned him the nicknames "the Wise Son of Corellia"<ref name="Lost Suns 1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref> and "the Quiet Healer."<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Near the end of the war, around [[3653 BBY]], Bakarn joined fellow Knights [[Satele Shan]], [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Jaric Kaedan]] during the [[Battle of Rhen Var|battle]] on the [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. Rhen Var had been captured earlier by the [[Dark Council]] member and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Mekhis]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemist]], who intended to use the world to test her new creations. The Jedi and the Republic army landed on the surface of Rhen Var and embarked on a march toward Darth Mekhis's fortress. The Republic's [[Forty-fifth Battalion]] was dispatched ahead to the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of Rhen Var as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] force for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the main [[Army/Legends|army]], but while on the scouting mission, they were attacked by the Empire's weaponized [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gas. By the time, the rest of the Republic forces reached them, all of the scouts were either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or close to dying. True to his duties as a Jedi healer, Bakarn attempted to ease the suffering of the dying scout [[Maxin Davers]], while Shan rallied Republic forces for a final push forward toward Darth Mekhis's fortress. Bakarn and the Republic army soon encountered and engeged a large detachment of the Empire's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and Sith but were able to defeat them. As the Republic laid siege to Mekhis's fortress, Shan personally infiltrated the compound and captured the Sith, ending the battle in a Republic victory.<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />

Shortly after that battle, a surprise peace offering came from the Empire, and [[Alderaan peace conference|negotiations]] were scheduled to take place on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where a peace treaty was to be discussed.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Republic sent a delegation of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including Bakarn, to Alderaan. Bakarn, remained excluded from the direct negotiations, so he waited for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] before the hearing room in the building of the [[High Council of Alderaan|High Council]]. Bakarn felt there that Leneer became increasingly restless and learned that she felt strange, which troubled him, although he did not trouble her as a threat. Shortly afterwards he felt a disturbance when he sensed Leneer's betrayal of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] denounced and attacked the two Sith warriors in their vicinity. Bakarn couldn't jeopardize the negotiations and tried to call her back but she did not hear him before [[Dar'Nala]] ordered them to stand down in which they obeyed. Eventually, Bakarn and Leneer were informed that the Sith had [[Sacking of Coruscant|conquered]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to force the Republic to make concessions in the negotiations. Leneer was extremely angry at this decision, and at the death of her master, and Syo attempted to comfort her after the incident. He offered her his help with anything she needed, but she declined to speak to him and later left the planet to search for her master's killer.<ref name="Decieved">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

[[File:Syo_Bakarn_on_Tython.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Master Syo Bakarn on Tython]]
After the end of the war, Bakarn relocated with the rest of the Order to their ancestral homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where he was responsible for many of the technical aspects of the new [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]], including the construction of the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|new Archives]].<ref name="Bakarn codex" /> During that time, he also founded the [[Jedi Restoration Concord]], a group of Jedi tasked with providing agricultural, engineering and constructional aid to Republic worlds devastated by the war with the Empire. One of the Concord's big achievement was made on the planet [[Uphrades]], where young Jedi serving the Concord quadrupled the planet's food production in just two years. Bakarn's selfless efforts in healing the scars of war did not go unnoticed and earned him the rank of Jedi Master and a seat on the Jedi High Council. Bakarn was especially close with a fellow Jedi named [[Duras Fain]]. On one occasion, the two of them pursued an Imperial fugitive to the moon of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. There, the Jedi met an aspiring technologist named [[Tharan Cedrax]], who helped them track the Imperial by building a tracking device. After that encounter, Bakarn, Fain and Cedrax became close friends. Although Bakarn did not approve of Cedrax's lifestyle, he continued to enlist his services in building technological advances for the Jedi Order.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===A promising student===
===The First Son===
[[File:Son_and_Nadien.png|thumb|right|170px|The First Son revealed]]
{{Quote|I never suspected. How many died because I never suspected?|A redeemed Syo Bakarn struggling to forgive himself|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Unbeknownst to most, including even Syo himself, the Emperor had created an alternate personality and implanted it into Syo's mind. This personality would be known as the First Son and leader of the [[Children of the Emperor]]. The First Son shielded the rest of the children from detection. Eventually, the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] defeated him, redeemed him, expelled the Emperor's influence in him as well as his identity as the First Son, and ultimately exposed the Emperor's Children to detection. The Barsen'thor eventually gained Syo Bakarn's seat on the Jedi Council.

===Confronting Tenebrae===
It is presumed that Jedi Master Bakarn had perished sometime after the Battle of Corellia. During the [[Alliance Commander]]'s confrontation with Tenebrae within the mind of Satele Shan, Master Bakarn was among the spirits that were summoned to help defeat the former Sith Emperor, thus ending his reign of terror once and for all. With the Emperor gone, Bakarn presumably became [[The Force/Legends|one with the Force]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' - Echoes of Oblivion. Bakarn appears briefly in a crowd of Force spirits during the battle; all other recognizable individuals in the crowd are deceased. Although it is possible for living individuals to enter mindscapes, all other living people in this mindscape are in close physical proximity to the individual whose mind it is (here Satele Shan); this is universally true for living people entering mindscapes (e.g., [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]] - Chapter 9) throughout the game, which suggests that physical proximity is required. As Bakarn is not near Shan, it is highly unlikely that he could have entered the mindscape while alive.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Defeating Syo Bakarn, as the First Son of the Emperor, is the finale of the Jedi Consular's storyline. As the fate of Syo is player determined, Syo can be killed, even when the Barsen'thor tries to redeem him. The First Son takes over and viciously hammers away at the Jedi Master, forcing them to blast Bakarn into a cave wall which collapses on him. He was cremated at the Jedi Temple without a ceremony, as by his final request.

Despite being a major character in the Consular story, Syo Bakarn also makes an appearance in the Jedi Knight storyline by attending [[Kira Carsen]]'s hearing and agreeing with [[Tol Braga]] that no one was beyond redemption.
